fields.name: MapAttributeMissingException.ShardElement
fields.contract: MapAttributeMissingException.ShardElement exposes one finite element-category selection. A caller may select exactly ShardId, RecordId, ChildId, GrandChildId, or GreatGrandChildId; no other named category is part of this public type. These five categories correspond one-for-one, in the same declared order, to MapShardKeyAttribute's five name properties — ShardId to ShardIdName, RecordId to RecordIdName, ChildId to ChildIdName, GrandChildId to GrandChildIdName, and GreatGrandChildId to GreatGrandChildIdName — so the enum and the attribute's property set encode the same shard-key identity ladder in two different forms.
